prompt:
The maps below show the village of Ferndale in 1985 and the same village in 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
instruction_line: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

visual.alt: Two maps showing the village of Ferndale side by side in 1985 and 2020: farmland has been replaced by a housing estate, the school has been enlarged, the shop has become a supermarket, the main road has been widened, and a footbridge has been added over the river.

key_points: Over 35 years the village changes from a rural settlement into a much denser one
All of the farmland north of the main road is converted into a housing estate — this is the biggest change
The school stays in the same place but its area is noticeably enlarged
The shop east of the road is replaced by a supermarket with a car park beside it
The main road is widened; a new footbridge is built over the river
Two features stay unchanged: the woodland in the north-east and the existing houses south of the road
common_mistakes: Not using direction and location language ('in the north of the village', 'to the east of the main road', 'opposite')
Describing the two maps separately without highlighting the change — change is the real focus of this task
Mixing up tenses; using the present simple for the past and the past tense for the present
Never mentioning the features that stay unchanged (the woodland, the houses)
Commenting on the change ('this made life better for residents')
